datasets.purpose: Acutely Food Insecure Population Estimates in different scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across South Sudan to estimate populations in different acute food insecurity scenarios. Population estimates were classified and aggregated to produce most likely acutely food insecure population figures for 2019, representing direct impacts of food system disruption.
